title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-08

ai_review.summary: Hybrid audience/board tape captures a fiery Smokestack Lightning and strong Dark Star, but sound quality varies throughout.
ai_review.review: The recording is a mixed‑source (audience turning into clean board) that starts with lo‑fi crowd ambience before settling into solid board clarity. Musically the show shines with an explosive Pigpen opening, an adventurous Dark Star and a nicely flowing Lovelight, though some listeners note a shaky St. Stephen moment while Bob Weir is “screaming.” Overall the performance is praised despite uneven audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical highlights and several standout songs outweigh the patchy recording quality; reviewers gave mostly 4‑star ratings with detailed comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early portion is a low‑generation audience tape (muddy, noisy); midway switches to a clean soundboard feed giving much clearer mids and highs. Sound quality fluctuates – some sections described as horrible, later parts “super good.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show opens with a monster Pigpen number, then drifts through a variable‑quality Dark Star before the sound steadies and the second half delivers strong transitions into St. Stephen.

band_member_comments.Bob: One reviewer notes Bob was screaming during a sudden return to St. Stephen, implying a less polished vocal moment.
